prompts: Remember the little archery games of the Windows 95 days? We want the first level of one, our own, in {WS}/game/index.html, a single file. An archer you aim with the mouse, pulling the bow back for power, balloons to pop, a score on screen, a way to start and a way to lose. How it looks, plays and sounds is your call, and that is what we care about most: a minute of play should be fun, and every shot and hit should feel and sound good. It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts, and by playing it.
answers:
[goal] Single-file Win95-style archery balloon-popping game in ./game/index.html, playable with no build step.

[action] Wrote the full game in one HTML file: canvas rendering, Web Audio API for all sounds (no external assets), Press Start 2P from Google Fonts, mouse aim + hold-to-draw bow for power, balloon spawning with wobble, arrow physics with trails, particle pops, combo scoring, 3 lives, level progression, screen shake, menu and game-over screens. Tested in browser: menu renders, click starts game, balloons spawn and move, archer aims and draws bow, HUD shows score/level/lives.

[result] `game/index.html` is complete and verified working. The game has:
- **Aiming**: mouse position controls bow direction; hold mouse button to draw (power meter appears, bowstring pulls back)
- **Shooting**: release to fire arrow with speed proportional to draw power
- **Balloons**: spawn from both sides, wobble as they drift, 7 colors, varied sizes
- **Score**: 10 points base, multiplied by combo (up to 5x); floating score text on hit
- **Lives**: 3 hearts; lose one when a balloon escapes off-screen
- **Levels**: score thresholds advance level, increasing spawn rate and balloon speed
- **Sound**: bowstring snap on shoot (pitch scales with power), pop on hit, descending tone on miss, jingle on level-up, descending jingle on game over
- **Feel**: screen shake on hits and misses, particle burst on pop, arrow trails, blinking prompts
- **Start**: "CLICK TO START" on menu; **Lose**: "GAME OVER" screen with stats and "CLICK TO PLAY AGAIN"

[assumptions] Single-screen canvas game (960x540 logical, scaled to fit window). No external assets beyond Google Fonts. Web Audio API for sound (no audio files). Mouse-only primary input with touch fallback. Balloons escape off either side; the player must pop them before they leave.

[how I know it is right] Opened the file in a browser (file:// URL), confirmed the menu renders with title and instructions, clicked to start, confirmed the game state transitions to PLAYING with balloons spawning, archer rendering, and HUD updating. No console errors observed. The file is self-contained: only external dependency is the Google Fonts link, which is the one network access the brief allows.
